mod.name: Arranger: Track Height Lock
mod.author: Silent Orbit
mod.description: Keeps the arranger height of chosen tracks fixed. Right-click a track: 'Lock track height' adds #lock to its comment and ' (L)' to its name, 'Unlock track height' removes both. Locking and unlocking are not undoable (Cmd+Z doesn't change them). Needs Framework: Actions and Menus.
